a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost guarantees we both fail. The first storm will likely hit right after round 1. So I'm departing from the agreement and taking 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better idea that actually beats the storm odds, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
